title: Cheaper communication does not remove governance work
text: Foss argues that firms and markets must be compared as ways to govern specific transactions. Adaptation when conditions change, relationship-specific investments and difficult-to-measure performance remain relevant even when exchanging information becomes easier. This challenges any automatic inference from AI capability to a flat organisation or universal outsourcing.
qualification: Economic argument, not an empirical forecast. The appropriate boundary depends on the particular business and transaction.
